The main takeaway from our work is that
lytic virus genomes interact directly and specifically with sites of cellular damage, which are a source of cellular machinery for virus genome replication and expression.

MVM can be targeted specifically to sites of cellular DNA double strand breaks (DSBs) to amplify its lytic life cycle, which may have implications for targeting virus to sites of cellular damage in cancer and other disease states.
